subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word.

"Today's __whether __is very pleasant", said Maya.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"whether"** means expressing doubt or a choice between alternatives. It is used in sentences to indicate possibilities or conditions. (क्या)

 
 
• **Example:** I don't know whether to stay or leave.
 
 
 
• **"Weather"** refers to the state of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, such as temperature, humidity, precipitation, etc. (मौसम)
 
 
• **Example:** The weather today is sunny and warm.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct spelling to describe atmospheric conditions in the sentence is **"Weather"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Wether** (भेड़ा): Refers to a male sheep, especially one that has been castrated.

 
 
• **Example:** The farmer bought a wether for his flock.
 
 
 
• **Wheather** (अमान्य शब्द): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have any valid meaning in English.
 
• **Weathur** (अमान्य शब्द): This is also an incorrect spelling and does not have any valid meaning in English.
